Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
vehicles.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
RepairVehicle, SaleVehicle
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object implements Cloneable
Abstract base class representing a generic vehicle.

Provides common attributes (brand and model) shared by all vehicle subtypes (RepairVehicle and SaleVehicle). This class cannot be instantiated directly.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
